glossary.scope: As used in sections 101.82 to 101.87 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Abolish" means to repeal the statutes creating and empowering an agency, remove its personnel, and transfer its records to the department of administrative services pursuant to division (E) of section 149.331 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 101.82 to 101.87 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Terminate" means to amend or repeal the statutes creating and empowering an agency, remove its personnel, and reassign its functions and records to another agency or officer designated by the general assembly.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 101.82 to 101.87 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Transfer" means to amend the statutes creating and empowering an agency so that its functions, records, and personnel are conveyed to another agency or officer.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 101.82 to 101.87 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition:
(E) "Renew" means to continue an agency, and may include amendment of the statutes creating and empowering the agency, or recommendations for changes in agency operation or personnel.
